about: Saved by the rules at git 78be455 (steady, 12 days)

moments: Pip picked up a first job. The island is waking up.
Pip is now gathering fallen branches by the old tree.
The first building on the island: a Rain catcher.

arrivals: Wren climbed up a hanging vine.
moments: Wren is the first new helper to find the island.
Wren is now gathering fallen branches by the old tree.
The Sawmill blade turns for the first time. Focus makes planks from now on.

surprise.text: A warm breeze carried in rich soil from somewhere far below.

arrivals: Moss climbed up a hanging vine.
moments: Moss is now sawing planks at the mill.

surprise.text: Loose stones tumbled from the cliff on Home island into a tidy pile.
A hot-air balloon is drifting past Home island. Someone in the basket waved.

arrivals: a large mossy island drifted in: Mossy Hollow. Only here can you build a Mushroom grotto.
moments: Your first new island! A bridge of mist hangs between it and home until you build a real one.
The Mushroom grotto is the first of its kind on Mossy Hollow.

surprise.text: Fireflies gathered over Mossy Hollow for the evening.
A rare golden sapling sprouted on Mossy Hollow. It will stay there for good.
